question: Which of the following awards was won by Lata Mangeshkar in the year 2001?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Ratna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar** is one of the most renowned playback singers in India, known for her melodious voice and a vast repertoire of songs in various Indian languages.
 
• She was awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in the year **2001** for her exceptional contribution to Indian music and arts.
 
• The Bharat Ratna is awarded in recognition of exceptional service/performance of the highest order in any field of human endeavour.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar is often referred to as the** Swar Kokila** for her contribution to Indian music over several decades.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award**

 
 
• This award is presented by Filmfare as part of its annual Filmfare Awards for Hindi films.
 
• It is given to individuals for their outstanding contribution to the Indian film industry over their lifetime.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar received this award in 1993.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan**
 
 
• It is the second-highest civilian award in India, given for exceptional and distinguished service.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar was honored with the Padma Vibhushan in 1999.
 
 
 
• **Dadasaheb Phalke Award**
 
 
• This is India's highest award in cinema, presented annually at the National Film Awards ceremony by the Directorate of Film Festivals.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award in 1989 for her outstanding contribution to the growth and development of Indian cinema.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Ratna**
 
 
• The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award of India, instituted in 1954.
 
• It is conferred for exceptional service/performance of the highest order in any field of human endeavour.
 
• The award does not carry any monetary grant or pension but is a recognition of the highest degree of service to the nation.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar received the Bharat Ratna in 2001.
